ValidationRule.description: If Drive SIte is selected then Site TBD should be unchecked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR(
AND( Drive_Site__c <> null, Site_TBD__c = true, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Mobile_Opp') ,
AND( Drive_Site__c = null, ISCHANGED(Site_TBD__c), Site_TBD__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Mobile_Opp')
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select either Drive Site or Site TBD
